items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Doug Watkins was one of the younger members of that family. I forget some of the names, but there’s always – there were some great musicians working around there.

ctx.x: Billy Mitchell plays tenor. There were some good trumpet players. There was a family of bass players. Doug Watkins was one of the younger members of that family. I forget some of the names, but there’s always – there were some great musicians working around there. It was really wonderful. It was a great time for me. I had a wonderful time.
How did that affect your life? Did it reinforce where you were going?
